title: Make Repo Chat Send Button Pink
specification:
# PRD: Make Repo Chat Send Button Pink

Priority: low

## Problem
The Repo Chat submit CTA does not match the requested visual treatment, and it currently shares the global `button.primary` styling so a naive color change would also recolor other primary actions.

## Goal
Give only the `Send to repo agent` button a pink visual treatment in the project control-plane UI without changing other primary buttons.

## Requirements
- Add a dedicated class or selector for the Repo Chat submit button instead of relying only on the shared `button.primary` rule.
- Apply a pink visual treatment to that chat submit button, preferably using the existing `--accent-2` design token or a scoped equivalent for default, hover, and focus states.
- Preserve the current chat submit behavior, label, disabled state, and form wiring.
- Do not change the appearance of `Queue PRD` or `Review PRD draft` buttons.

## Acceptance Criteria
- In the project control-plane Repo Chat panel, the `Send to repo agent` button renders pink.
- The `Queue PRD` buttons and the `Review PRD draft` button keep their current non-pink styling.
- The chat form still submits normally and the send button continues to reflect disabled or sending states correctly.

## Verification
- Add or update a focused control-plane UI test so the chat submit button has a dedicated styling hook.
- Run the control-plane chat/UI unit tests, including `tests/unit/control-plane-chat-prd-draft-ui.test.ts` and any render test covering `buildControlPlaneHtml`.
